commit.message:
Prepare `BUILD.bazel` files for Copybara workflow

- Add `BUILD.bazel` files under `build_tools` and `stablehlo/integrations/cpp/builder`.

- Rename `examples/c++` directory to `examples/cpp` to sanitize package paths.

See [RFC](https://github.com/openxla/stablehlo/pull/2980) for context.
